items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very happy to have Dawoud Sabu Adeyola with me this morning.

ctx.x: Sabu was interviewed via Zoom on January 30, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very happy to have Dawoud Sabu Adeyola with me this morning. And welcome, sir.
